d:
Even for Buddy Valastro, some cake creations demand extraordinary skill, patience, and creativity. On Cake Boss, Buddy and his team at Carlo's Bakery take on elaborate cakes and demanding custom designs that put their professional cake decorating abilities to the test. From intricate details to ambitious themed cakes, discover the challenges behind turning creative ideas into amazing cakes.
Watch Cake Boss Season 8 Episodes 7, 15, 4, 26, 11, 1 and 17 only on discovery+ India.
